description: Source code for a CustomRetriever class implementing a vector store retriever with customizable result formatting, including methods for initialization, document retrieval, and metadata replacement.

classes.name: CustomRetriever_Retrievers
classes.description: A retriever class implementing INode, providing document retrieval based on a vector store with customizable output formats.

classes.name: CustomRetriever
classes.description: A generic class extending VectorStoreRetriever, enabling retrieval of documents with formatted content based on a template.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the retriever based on node data inputs, returning different outputs depending on the specified output type.

methods.name: getRelevantDocuments
methods.description: Retrieves relevant documents from the vector store and formats their content based on the resultFormat template.

methods.name: fromVectorStore
methods.description: Static method to create a CustomRetriever instance from a vector store and options.

methods.name: replaceMetadata
methods.description: Replaces metadata placeholders in a template string with actual metadata values.
